title: Titanium EDC Pen Body
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is chosen for Titanium EDC Pen Body where scratch resistance (hardness 36 HRC) and premium tactile feel differentiate the user experience. Its thermal conductivity (6.7 W/mK) is 85% lower than aluminum, reducing heat transfer to the skin surface in handheld devices. The alpha-beta microstructure enables thin-wall CNC profiling to <0.5mm wall thickness while maintaining structural rigidity under 3-point bending — essential for Everyday carry bolt-action pen body. This rationale is driven by everyday carry bolt-action pen body and fat life requirements.
process: CNC milling HSM 30k RPM for edc geometry
Tumble finish ceramic media with SPC sampling
PVD TiN/TiCN coating with SPC sampling
Optical Keyence inspection with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: PVD TiAlN coating (2-3um, HV2500 hardness) for scratch resistance and uniform gunmetal aesthetic finish — tailored for everyday carry boltaction application
inspection: Salt spray ASTM B117 (everyday carry verified)
commonFailures: Anodic color shift DE >2.0 from inconsistent bath temp - requires ±1C electrolyte control during PVD — critical for everyday carry boltaction performance

faq.q: What cosmetic surface defect standards apply to Titanium EDC Pen Body?
faq.a: Titanium EDC Pen Body is inspected to consumer electronics cosmetic standards: no visible scratches >0.1 mm width under 500 lux illumination at 30 cm viewing distance. Color variation across surfaces ≤ΔE 1.0 (CIE Lab). Edge break radius 0.2-0.5 mm, no burrs >0.05 mm. PVD coating adhesion verified by tape test ASTM D3359 Class 4B minimum.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium EDC Pen Body orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium EDC Pen Body is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium EDC Pen Body?
faq.a: Each Titanium EDC Pen Body shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for everyday carry boltaction.
